median_sentence: (d) The median move of the 10 AI names is +3.69% vs Friday's official close, compared with +3.12% for the Nasdaq-100 perp vs the ^NDX close, a gap of +0.57 percentage points.
caveats: These are synthetic USDC-settled perpetual contracts on Hyperliquid's trade.xyz builder dex, not official exchange prices and not the underlying shares. They trade 24/7, including while cash markets are shut. Research only, not investment advice.

Nasdaq-100 benchmark: the xyz:XYZ100 perp tracks trade.xyz's own modified market-cap-weighted index of 100 large non-financial US-listed companies. It is not a licensed Nasdaq-100 contract, so its move vs the official ^NDX close is a level check only.

Weekend pricing: per trade.xyz's Specification Index, US single-stock perps are in an internal session from Friday 8:00 PM ET to Sunday 8:05 PM ET (SoftBank: outside Tokyo-linked hours 8:20 AM–11:59 PM JST and at weekends). Per trade.xyz's Oracle Price docs, the oracle then starts from the last external price and moves only with the perp order book (EMA, 30-minute time constant), so it brings in no new outside information.

Liquidity is thin at weekends: 24h volume ranged from about $274m (NVDA) to about $0.24m (SoftBank) at the snapshot. Low-volume rows (AVGO, ORCL, SoftBank) can move on small orders; Nasdaq-100 perp 24h volume was about $439m.
Funding is paid hourly between longs and shorts and can pull the perp away from fair value. It is not shown in the table; the API's current 1h rates at the snapshot are in the data file.

Mark price = Hyperliquid mark, which uses the oracle and the order book. Oracle and mark can differ; at the snapshot the largest gap was 0.16% (SOFTBANK oracle 17.986 vs mark 18.015). Last-trade times come from the API's recentTrades call at the snapshot (SoftBank's last trade was at 06:58, i.e. its mark may be stale).

Cross-check: hyperliquidguide.com/markets is a Cloudflare-cached snapshot from Sun 22 Nov 07:36 Europe/Zurich (page about 24 hours old), vs the API at 07:21 Europe/Zurich on Mon 23 Nov. The guide's prices are -3.2% to -0.4% away from the API marks (guide minus API); this is timing from the stale cache, not a data error. No guide price was found for Alphabet. The guide's 24h change is vs the price 24h earlier, not vs the official close.

Official closes: Friday 20 Nov 2026 from Yahoo Finance daily history (^NDX for the Nasdaq-100). SoftBank's USD close is derived (d) from ¥3,025 ÷ USD/JPY 159.707 (Yahoo JPY=X, 20 Nov daily close); a different FX rate changes the move. SoftBank's Tokyo close came before Friday's US session, so part of its move reflects Friday US trading, not only weekend news.
Moves vs close and the median comparison are own arithmetic (d). The AI-names median includes Anthropic (ANT) and SoftBank. Research only — not investment advice.
